title: Index of an even-partite book vertex
statement: Let $r$ and $k$ be natural numbers with $k>0$. For a vertex $v$ in the book with $2r$ parts and $k$ vertices per part, identify the vertices with the integers from $0$ to $2rk-1$ using the specified enumeration. Dividing the index of $v$ in this enumeration by $k$ gives the index of its part.
hypotheses_covered: $v$ is a vertex in the book with $2r$ parts and $k$ vertices per part
